editorial_scope: Brewing heat, CO2 capture, wastewater bioenergy and the industrial history of refrigeration and beer exports; research synthesis, not operating or safety advice.

sources.title: Generalized electrification solutions for breweries: Pinch Analysis and heat pump integration (2026)
sources.author_label: Roger Padullés, Martin Pihl Andersen, Niklas Bagge Mogensen and colleagues
sources.access_scope: Full public Danish Technical University research entry and journal abstract; final CC BY article linked, but design inputs were not independently re-calculated. Generalized brewery model, not measured results at every plant.

sources.title: Electrification and decarbonization in global brewing industry driven by industrial heat pumps (2025)
sources.author_label: Zhongyi Liu, Bin Hu, Di Wu and Ruzhu Wang
sources.access_scope: Public publisher abstract of a global sector model under assumed boiler and electricity scenarios; article full methods not independently read. Potential avoided emissions are model outputs, not measured reductions.

sources.title: Field test and evaluation of improving alternatives in brewing thermal process (2025)
sources.author_label: Jiajie Huang and colleagues
sources.access_scope: Publisher abstract and highlights of one large Chinese brewery's steam and wort-cooling changes; methods not fully accessible, findings not a universal brewhouse benchmark.

sources.title: Sustainability Manuals: Energy Sustainability (9 June 2026)
sources.author_label: Brewers Association Sustainability Subcommittee
sources.access_scope: Public Brewers Association directory discussing brewery energy management and greenhouse gas reduction; detailed manual content not separately verified.

sources.title: Sustainability Benchmarking Reports (1 February 2026)
sources.author_label: Brewers Association
sources.access_scope: Public resource summary of water, wastewater, energy, solid waste and GHG benchmarking; underlying private brewery records and detailed values not accessed.

sources.title: Valorisation of Carbon Dioxide from Fermentation in Craft Brewing: Potential Technologies, Brewer Interviews, and Three-Level System (2025)
sources.author_label: Théo Grand, David Jenkins, Dawn Maskell and Shiwen Zhuang
sources.access_scope: Publisher indexed full-text excerpts including five semi-structured interviews with French craft breweries, technology options and conceptual shared infrastructure; direct full page intermittently gave 403. Not an implemented regional CO2 network.

sources.title: GHG Protocol Calculation Tools FAQ: emissions scopes and biogenic reporting
sources.author_label: Greenhouse Gas Protocol / World Resources Institute
sources.access_scope: Full public accounting FAQ distinguishing scopes 1/2/3 and separately reported biogenic CO2 from biomass combustion; specific fermentation carbon-cycle calculation requires its own applicable guidance.

sources.title: Closed loop supply chains enable carbon reduction and resource circularity in the brewing industry (2025)
sources.author_label: Wu Hao, Liu Lijing, Qu Tianxiao and Kim Hae-young
sources.access_scope: Full open published paper discussing Tsingtao operational measures, CO2 capture, packaging and reported Scope 1/2 changes; site data and upstream comparisons not independently audited.

sources.title: Bioelectrochemically Enhanced Anaerobic Digestion of Brewery Wastewater at Ambient Temperature (2026)
sources.author_label: Seyedomid Ahmadinejad, Shuyao Wang, Banu Ormeci and colleagues
sources.access_scope: Full PubMed abstract of one 365-day upflow brewery wastewater reactor with comparisons against conventional digestion; full protocol and economic feasibility not independently evaluated.

sources.title: Comparative Evaluation of Mesophilic and Thermophilic Anaerobic Digestion for Microbrewery Waste Streams (2026)
sources.author_label: Industrial bioresource recovery researchers
sources.access_scope: Public journal abstract describing characterized acidic organic and alkaline cleaning streams, methane potential and CO2 scrubbing within one experimental system; full article returned rate limiting and was not re-analyzed.

sources.title: Techno-economic and life-cycle analysis of renewable natural gas from brewery wastewater (2025)
sources.author_label: Xuanbo Liu, Tuhin K. Poddar, Jingyi Zhang, Xueqian Su and colleagues
sources.access_scope: Full PubMed abstract describing four modeled hydrogen and methanation scenarios, capital/price ranges and lifecycle emissions; not an actual operating brewery's certified gas production.

sources.title: Small Breweries, Large Footprints? Environmental Implications of Brewing Waste (2026)
sources.author_label: Environmental research review authors
sources.access_scope: Public indexed review covering variable wastewater COD, BOD, pH, solids and treatment options; cited ranges span different facilities, not universal discharge permissions.

sources.title: Brewery Byproducts as Bioenergy Sources: A Review of Biohydrogen and Biomethane Production (2026)
sources.author_label: Waste and Biomass Valorization review authors
sources.access_scope: Full open literature synthesis of brewery organic wastes, digester configurations, microbial interaction and resource limits; not actual gas production at a named brewery.

sources.title: Food Waste Utilisation in Beer Production: Enablers and Barriers in European Craft Brewing (2025)
sources.author_label: Milica Končar
sources.access_scope: Full public abstract studying seven craft practitioners in four European countries; survey of organizational barriers, not representative consumer tasting or ingredient safety testing.

sources.title: Circular Valorization of Brewer’s Spent Grain and Brewer’s Yeast (2026)
sources.author_label: Sustainability 2026 circular bioeconomy review authors
sources.access_scope: Public abstract of 38 selected papers from 2010–2024 comparing food, feed, energy and material reuse; not certification of a particular byproduct food/feed lot.

sources.title: Refrigeration: Something's Brewing exhibit
sources.author_label: University of Chicago Library
sources.access_scope: Full public archival overview of natural ice, ice houses and Carl von Linde's 1870s ammonia refrigeration developments; museum exhibition synthesis rather than complete independent archival research.

sources.title: Cool beer — all year round (April 2026)
sources.author_label: Géraldine Lysser for Swiss National Museum
sources.access_scope: Full public museum history of Swiss ice harvesting, cellars, rail transport and mechanical refrigeration, including Hürlimann's 1879 adoption; image rights not reproduced.

sources.title: Export of beer from the 1860s — enabling technologies
sources.author_label: Ingebjørg Eidhammer, Norwegian Museum of Science and Technology
sources.access_scope: Full public museum page outlining Norwegian breweries' export networks from 1860 to 1900 and their access to natural ice, steamships, railways and archival holdings; not a complete shipment dataset.

sources.title: Ammonia Fittings, museum catalogue nmah_2037477
sources.author_label: Smithsonian National Museum of American History
sources.access_scope: Full public object entry for two Fred W. Wolf ammonia refrigeration fittings catalogues, one dated 1899; does not record the date every brewery adopted a machine, images not reproduced.

sources.title: Potential utilisation methods for brewer's spent grain: a review (2025)
sources.author_label: International Journal of Food Science and Technology review authors
sources.access_scope: Public abstract of opportunities for spent grain in materials, biosorbents and circular processes; not a direct assessment of particular commercial beer or waste treatment.

sources.title: Evaluating integration of biogenic CO2 from alcoholic fermentation in utilization strategies (2025)
sources.author_label: Abdessamad Gueddari, Carlos Alonso-Moreno, Jesús Canales-Vázquez and Santiago García-Yuste
sources.access_scope: Publisher abstract on biogenic CO2 capture from winery fermentation tanks; explicitly winery-focused, cannot be used for a brewery-specific gas purity or economics claim.
